title: Yomi Config
description: Configuration schema for the Yomi agent system.

name.description: Agent identity name. Substituted into the {{name}} placeholder of system_prompt.

default_model.description: Default model name for new sessions (points to a model in Config.models).

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations per agent session.

enable_subagent.description: Allow the agent to spawn sub-agents.

system_prompt.description: Custom system prompt override; supports the {{name}} placeholder. If omitted, the built-in default prompt is used.

tool_blocklist.description: Regex patterns for tools that should be disabled.

compactor.description: Context compaction settings for managing long conversations.

micro_compact_enabled.description: Enable client-side micro-compaction before full compaction. Disabled by default to preserve prompt-cache reuse.

threshold_ratio.description: Ratio (0.0–1.0) of the context window at which compaction is triggered.

keep_recent_messages.description: Number of recent messages to preserve during full compaction.

keep_recent_tool_results.description: Number of recent messages whose tool results survive micro-compaction.

summary_max_tokens.description: Max tokens allocated for generating a summary during full compaction.

max_tool_output_length.description: Maximum tool output length in bytes.

data_dir.description: Data directory for persistent storage. Supports ~ expansion.

log_dir.description: Log directory. Defaults to <data_dir>/logs if omitted.

skill_folders.description: List of skill folder paths, ordered by precedence (low → high): on name collision the later folder wins. Defaults to [~/.agents/skills, <data_dir>/skills] if omitted.

all.description: Enable every feature that is not explicitly overridden.

update_session_title.description: Generate session titles with a model. Inherits from all when omitted.

max_checkpoints.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to retain per session.

gc.description: Garbage-collection policy for expired session resources. Whether a run actually deletes (dry_run) is controlled by the CLI only and is not configurable.

retention_days.description: Sessions are retained for this many days after their last update before gc collects them.

sweep_orphans.description: Sweep orphan files whose session no longer exists in the DB.

vacuum.description: Run VACUUM + WAL truncate after deletion.

auto.description: Run gc automatically in the daemon: once at startup (catching up for downtime), then every day at local midnight. Performs real deletions.

socket_auth_hash.description: Socket auth password hash (`blake3:<hex>`), enforced on ws/wss transports only; unix sockets rely on filesystem permissions. YOMI_SOCKET_AUTH_HASH overrides. Omit = no auth. Generate with `yomi daemon auth-hash --generate`.

allowed_chats.description: Chat IDs that are allowed to access this channel. Empty means allow all. Messages mentioning the bot from other chats get a denial reaction instead of a reply.

allowed_users.description: User IDs that are allowed to access this channel. Empty means allow all. Messages mentioning the bot from other users get a denial reaction instead of a reply.

blocked_chats.description: Chat IDs that are blocked. Blocked chats are ignored silently (no feedback).

blocked_users.description: User IDs that are blocked. Blocked users are ignored silently (no feedback).

require_mention.description: Whether the bot must be mentioned to respond.

reply_in_thread.description: Whether group-chat replies are anchored to the triggering message so they land in its thread (Feishu thread reply, Telegram quote-reply). Private chats are unaffected.

observability.description: Status card + run receipts for run observability. When disabled, channels behave as before (ack reaction + final reply).

tool_trace.description: Attach the run trace (tool calls + intermediate texts) to the final reply bubble: a collapsible panel on card-capable platforms (Feishu, requires client V7.9+), plain-text lines elsewhere. When disabled, the final reply is the bare text.

mid_run_split.description: When the user posts messages mid-run, freeze the status card in place as a terminal receipt and deliver the final reply as a NEW message below them (carrying the run trace). When disabled, the status card always morphs into the final reply in place (one message per run).

history_context.description: Recent-chat messages injected as context when the bot is triggered in a group (fetched since the last trigger in that thread/chat, newest cap; 0 disables; capped at 50 per platform page).

approval_chat_id.description: Target group chat_id for Feishu doc-permission application notifications. When unset, every admin in admin_users is notified by DM instead; when both are unset the feature is off (applications are only logged, queryable via /permits). Note: docs events are two-level — each document also needs one file-level subscribe API call (POST /open-apis/drive/v1/files/{token}/subscribe?file_type=docx, body {"event_type":"drive.file.permission_member_applied_v1"}) or no event is generated.

admin_users.description: Admin open_ids allowed to approve/deny doc-permission applications (card buttons and /permits /approve /deny commands alike). Also the DM recipients when approval_chat_id is unset.

disabled_events.description: Platform event features disabled at runtime (vocabulary is per-platform; Feishu currently supports doc_comment = doc comment triggers). Event delivery itself requires console-side subscription — this disables reacting without a console trip. Unknown names only warn at startup; unset = all enabled.

env.description: General-purpose environment variables injected at startup, overriding host values. Keys are used verbatim and do not require the YOMI_ prefix.

tasks.description: Lightweight task configuration (e.g., auto title generation).

fast_model.description: Model key used for lightweight tasks. Falls back to the session model when absent.

models.description: Multi-model configuration array. At least one model is required.

name.description: Unique model identifier used in the config (e.g., 'claude_sonnet', 'gpt4o').

model_id.description: Actual model ID sent to the API (e.g., 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022').

fallback_model_id.description: Fallback model ID to use if this model is unavailable.

thinking.description: Thinking / reasoning configuration for supported models.

effort.description: Reasoning effort level (low/medium/high) for OpenAI o1/o3 models.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with API requests.

context_window.description: Context window size for this model.

extensions.description: Wire-protocol external extensions spawned alongside the daemon (TOML: [[extensions]]). Listed = launched with the daemon, group-killed when it dies, restarted with fixed backoff on crash.
